paragraphs: Per the file, due to the lack (per the file) of core protocol support (per the file) for distributing block revenue to stakers, nodes have developed their own (per the file) solutions which are not (per the file) enforced by the core protocol. Per the file, for example, the Cogent node diverts part of its (per the file) fee revenue to NFT holders. Per the file, but it's up the (per the file) NFT holders to audit and (per the file) hold Cogent accountable to a (per the file) specific commission rate. Per the file, another alternative is Jito's (per the file) mechanism for block "tips" (not (per the file) fees, but the idea is similar). Per the file, jito's node implementation includes a tip distribution (per the file) program which it instructs node operators to divert all of (per the file) their tips to but cannot (per the file) enforce perfect compliance.

Per the file, it's up to stakers (per the file) and the Jito team to (per the file) audit compliance by node operators. Per the file, this mechanism calls for trusting a third-party (in (per the file) this case Jito) to calculate (per the file) reward distribution in an accurate (per the file) and fair manner. sections.heading: Runtime: Block Revenue Collection
paragraphs: Per the file, after all txs are processed in a (per the file) block for a given (per the file) leader, rather than collecting (per the file) all block revenue into the node identity acct, the protocol will look (per the file) up the block producer's vote acct as described in [SIMD-0180]. Per the file, then it MUST check if the node's vote acct has specified a block revenue (per the file) commission rate and collector addresses (per the file) in the new vote acct version described in [SIMD-0185]. Per the file, as described in [SIMD-0232], (per the file) the latest block revenue commission (per the file) rate and collector address MUST (per the file) be loaded from the vote acct state at the beginning of (per the file) the previous epoch. Per the file, this is the same vote acct state used to build (per the file) the leader schedule for the current epoch.

Per the file, if the block revenue (per the file) commission rate and collector acct aren't set (e.g., the vote acct state version has not been updated (per the file) to v4 yet), all revenue is to be collected into the node's identity acct as before. Per the file, if the block revenue (per the file) commission rate and collector acct *are* specified, the rewards (per the file) MUST be distributed according (per the file) to the commission and (per the file) delegator rewards collection sections below. Per the file, commission Collection The commission (per the file) amount MUST be calculated (per the file) by first multiplying the (per the file) amount of revenue by (per the file) the lesser of the vote acct's block revenue commission rate (per the file) or the maximum of 10,000 (per the file) basis points.

Per the file, then use integer division (per the file) to divide by 10,000 (per the file) and discard the remainder. Per the file, if the commission amount (per the file) is non-zero, the block (per the file) revenue commission collector acct MUST be loaded and checked (per the file) for the following conditions: acct is system program owned AND acct is rent-exempt after depositing the commission. Per the file, if the conditions are (per the file) met, the commission amount (per the file) MUST be deposited into (per the file) the block revenue commission collector acct. Per the file, if either of these (per the file) conditions is violated, the (per the file) commission amount MUST be burned. Per the file, delegator Rewards Collection The (per the file) delegator rewards amount MUST (per the file) be calculated by subtracting (per the file) the calculated commission from (per the file) the block fee revenue.

Per the file, if the delegator rewards (per the file) amount is non-zero, the vote acct has to be loaded and checked for (per the file) the following conditions: acct is vote program owned AND acct is initialized with vote state (per the file) v4 or later If the (per the file) conditions are met, the delegator (per the file) rewards amount MUST be added (per the file) to the vote state field (per the file) pending_delegator_rewards and added to the (per the file) balance of vote acct. Per the file, then for each vote acct, get its pending delegator (per the file) rewards from the pending_delegator_rewards (per the file) field in the vote state at (per the file) the end of reward epoch N - 1. Per the file, let this value be P. Per the file, if P is zero, skip this vote acct as there is nothing to be distributed. Per the file, lastly, if this is (per the file) the first block of (per the file) epoch N, the vote (per the file) state’s pending_delegator_rewards field MUST (per the file) be reset to 0.
